How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NDMA to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NDMA Young Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the NDMA Young Consultant (Forest Fire Risk Management) post is 06 September 2026. Ensure you complete your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Disaster Management, Bio-Science, Forestry, Agriculture, Environmental Science, Atmospheric Science, GIS, Geography, Geology, or Climatology from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Consultant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Consultant (Forest Fire Risk Management) position is 35 years. No minimum age limit is specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Consultant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000/- per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the post of Young Consultant (Forest Fire Risk Management) in the National Disaster Management Authority.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to submit their applications through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The position of Young Consultant (Forest Fire Risk Management) is on a contractual basis. This means the appointment will be for a fixed term as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job is based in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110029. Candidates should be willing to work in the National Capital Region.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment primarily involves Online Application Submission. Further details regarding subsequent stages, if any, would be available in the official notification.
